n4096 B2 (s6, ~12.8ms = the SINGLE most expensive shape) + n2048 B8 (s5). These are the LARGE-matrix shapes where FP8/NVFP4's 2-4x tensor-core peak ACTUALLY pays (the trailing/Gram GEMMs are big enough to be FLOP-bound, unlike the bandwidth-bound n512 trailing where FP8 was disproven). Build the dominant GEMM (n4096 is CholeskyQR-path: its Gram + the orhr_col recon ~49%; n2048 is the blocked trailing) in NVFP4 (per-16 e4m3 scale) or MXFP8 (per-32 E8M0) block-scaled tcgen05 + ONE FP32 residual-correction pass to hold the 1.2e-3 gate. Author the block-scaled GEMM in CuTe DSL modeling dense_blockscaled_gemm_persistent.py (fetch from NVIDIA/cutlass@main via WebFetch; NVF4 inputs row-major-K only; build scale layout via BlockScaledBasicChunk). M=128 atom is well-filled at n>=2048. This is the operator's explicit NVFP4/FP8 mandate. Read research doc Q1/Q2/Q6 #4.

n4096 FP16 trailing solve (1x FP16 FP32-accum replacing 3xTF32 in tri_solve_right_inv, gated set_trsm_lowp, ON for s6 B==2). 22 tests pass but diff_correctness FAILS on s6: Q orth residual 0.75-11.7 vs gate 0.0488 (15-240x over). Root cause: Q=A*R^-1 cond(A)~1.8e4, FP16 u~5e-4 -> orth loss ~kappa*u~9. n4096 TRSM precision-walled to >=TF32. Empirical disproof of FP16 on this GEMM.

Brief-0 (block-scaled NVFP4/MXFP8 GEMM on n4096 s6 + n2048 s5) EXHAUSTIVELY EXPLORED: 5 committed iters (3 validation_error disproofs + 2 succeeded) + isolated nsys + 3 standalone probes.
